about.title: A Saudi house of fire
about.story: Founded in the heart of Al-Ahsa, فحم النخلة was built on a single conviction: the world's finest charcoal is born from the world's most resilient tree. We work with over 200 Saudi palm farms, transforming pruned date-palm wood into export-grade charcoal trusted by chefs, exporters, and lounges from Riyadh to Tokyo.
